column5: Description

column4: Rahbar AI — Offline-first Edge-AI Teaching Assistant (Class 6 General Science MVP)
column5: Offline-first Android app: an on-device small language model generates curriculum-grounded lesson plans and 10-question MCQ tests, and grades MCQ answer sheets by camera — with no internet. MVP scope: General Science, Class 6 (PCTB textbook). Stack: Flutter (Android), on-device SLM via flutter_gemma/LiteRT, on-device RAG over the curriculum, OpenCV OMR, local SQLite.

column4: Set up Flutter (Android) project + dev toolchain + budget-device emulator
column5: Install Flutter/Android SDK, scaffold the app, and configure an emulator profile approximating a 2–4 GB RAM budget phone.
Wire the on-device inference plugin, load a quantized model, and stream generated tokens inside the app.
Benchmark candidate SLMs (Gemma 3n E2B / Qwen / Llama 3.2) for peak RAM, latency, and output quality on target hardware; select one.

column4: Curriculum OCR + layout parse of Class 6 textbook
column5: Run layout-aware OCR (Docling + Tesseract) over the scanned textbook; handle the watermark and separate figures from text.
Segment the parsed text into topic chunks with metadata (chapter, section, page, block type: content/activity/key-points/exercise).

column4: Embed chunks + build bundled vector DB
column5: Embed chunks with a compact English model and build a small on-device vector store shipped as an app asset.
Embed the query, run vector similarity search, and return top-k curriculum chunks (metadata-aware: prefer content over exercises).
Anti-hallucination prompting with structured (JSON) output; answer only from provided excerpts and flag when unknown.
Generate a full 50-minute lesson plan: Bloom-tagged objectives, revision starter, Socratic questions, low-cost activity, delivery, exit ticket; suggest splitting if too long.
Generate 10 mixed-difficulty questions (one correct + plausible distractors), an answer key, and a unique test ID.
Produce print-ready lesson plan, student MCQ paper, OMR answer sheet (fiducial markers + QR test ID), and teacher answer key.
Evaluate groundedness, curriculum-fit, MCQ validity, and retrieval hit-rate on a golden set of queries.
Capture with align guide, fiducial perspective-warp, decode test ID, look up the answer key, score, and flag low-confidence marks — without invoking the SLM.
Topic/SLO picker → generating state → sectioned, editable lesson plan → MCQ view → saved library.
Store generated plans, tests, answer keys, grading results, and settings locally.
Profile and tune memory/latency; ensure graceful low-RAM behavior and an instant-feel generation experience.
Teacher-style review of generated plans/MCQs for correctness, curriculum fit, and difficulty; fix issues found.
Prepare the demo script, seed content, README/architecture write-up, and a walkthrough.
